name: soil critical speed
domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 文中地基波传播特征与运行荷载速度相联系的临界速度。
usage_overview: 用于识别移动荷载作用下土体振动可能显著放大的速度条件，将荷载运行速度与土体波传播速度相联系，考察两者接近时的动力响应。

complete_examples.text: In this section, case studies are implemented for the analysis of soil infinite element position and soil critical speed respectively.
Therefore, it is necessary to reinforce the soil to avoid the low soil critical speed in practical engineering.
